visual_observations: All 34 producer contact sheets were reviewed in order; the coherent blue fluid wedge, grey bed/tank, and orange moving paddle remain identifiable.
The nine direct keyframes at 0, 100, 200, 300, 400, 500, 600, 700, and 800 show a weak non-breaking shoreline/free-surface disturbance and later return toward the initial wedge.
No blank, truncated, globally exploded, broad spray cloud, or obvious severe visible bed-through failure was seen.
Sparse downstream shoreline blue points remain visible in overview views; this is a disclosed display limitation, not a strict wall or container claim.

The visual record supports a weak-wave first-stage decision only; it does not support a large inundation/runup claim, exact free-surface transport claim, particle-level containment proof, numerical precision, or sub-DP proof.
